items.headline: Task force's October 15 agenda listed Station Area plan, crossing study
items.summary: The October 15 Station Area Task Force agenda included a public hearing on the Benton-Brokaw Multimodal Crossing Feasibility Study and a review of the complete draft Station Area Specific Plan.

items.headline: Aldeia Drive permits list new single-family construction
items.summary: Ten listed October 15 permits cover new single-family construction on Aldeia Drive, with declared permit valuations ranging from $424,925 to $641,692.

items.headline: City attorney interviews listed on October 10 council agenda
items.summary: The October 10 agenda listed a closed session for City Council to interview candidates for the City Attorney position.

items.headline: City attorney interviews listed on October 9 council agenda
items.summary: The October 9 agenda listed a closed session for City Council to interview candidates for the City Attorney position.

items.headline: October 6 agenda listed city attorney transition and compensation items
items.summary: The October 6 City Council agenda listed discussion of temporary legal services during a city attorney transition, compensation changes for unrepresented management and confidential employees, and a market-based pay adjustment for the city manager.
